app.name: Wayfare console
field.name: Name
signIn.title: Sign in to the console
signIn.lead: For Wayfare staff and venue owners.
signIn.googleNote: Venue owners can continue with Google. Staff sign in with their email and password.
signIn.registerLead: Own a venue in Hồ Chí Minh City?
signIn.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in to go back to where you were.
error.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don't match. Check both, or choose a new password with Forgot password?
error.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked. Write to support@wayfare.app and we'll help.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, then try again — or choose a new password.
error.GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_NOT_ALLOWED: Staff accounts sign in with their email and password, not Google.
error.ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED: This account was deactivated. Write to support@wayfare.app and we'll help.
error.GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED: Your Wayfare account is linked to a different Google account. Continue with that one, or sign in with your email.
error.GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE: Google didn't answer. Try again in a moment, or sign in with your email.
error.INVALID_GOOGLE_TOKEN: Google sign-in didn't finish. Continue with Google again, or sign in with your email.
error.GOOGLE_LINK_NEEDS_PASSWORD: This address already has a Wayfare account. Sign in with its email and password.
error.EMAIL_TAKEN: Another account now uses that address. Write to support@wayfare.app and we'll sort it out.
error.PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Add a password first: Google is this account's only way in.
error.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
error.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: Wayfare can't reach its servers. Pages keep what they showed, and we'll keep trying.
error.NETWORK_ERROR: You're offline. Pages keep what they showed; saving needs a connection.
error.INVALID_STATE: Someone changed this while you were editing. Reload to see their version; your changes are kept below.
error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps happening, send support the request ID.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Enter your account's email. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses {email}, we've sent a link to it. It works for one hour.
reset.title: Choose a new password
setup.title: Set your password
setup.lead: Welcome to the Wayfare console. Choose a password for {email} to finish setting up your account.
link.verified.title: Email confirmed
link.verified.body: {email} is confirmed. Nothing else to do.
link.changed.title: Your email is now {email}
link.changed.body: We sent a note to your old address, with a link in case this wasn't you.
link.reverted.title: Your old email is back
link.reverted.body: The change to {email} was undone, every device was signed out, and we sent a link to choose a new password.
link.recoveryStopped.title: Recovery stopped
link.recoveryStopped.body: Nobody can take over your account through that request. Your email and password are unchanged. If you didn't ask for it, tell support@wayfare.app.
link.recovery.title: Finish recovering your account
link.recovery.body: Choose a new password. Your account's email becomes {email}, and every device is signed out.
link.recovery.lead: Choose a new password. Your account's email becomes the address this link was sent to, and every device is signed out.
link.expired.title: This link no longer works
link.expired.body: It has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one, or sign in if you're done.
link.otherAccount.title: Done for the other account
link.otherAccount.body: This link was for {linkEmail}. You're still signed in as {email}.
nav.label: Sections
home.title: Home
home.leadStaff: Your queues and recent activity, at a glance.
home.leadOwner: Your venues and what needs you, at a glance.
home.emptyBody: Your sections are in the menu. What needs your attention will show here.
section.soonBody: This section's pages are on their way. Your other sections are in the menu.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Approvals, sales and billing news will show here.
time.minutesAgo: {count, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
time.hoursAgo: {count, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}
time.daysAgo: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
notification.OWNER_REGISTRATION_APPROVED: Your registration is approved. Add your first venue.
notification.OWNER_REGISTRATION_REJECTED: Your registration wasn't approved. See the note and apply again.
notification.SUBMISSION_APPROVED: {placeName} is approved. It goes live once its audio is ready.
notification.SUBMISSION_REJECTED: Your change to {placeName} wasn't approved. See the note from our team.
notification.PLACE_UNPUBLISHED: Wayfare took {placeName} off the map. Write to support to ask why.
notification.PLACE_EDITED_BY_ADMIN: Our team edited {placeName}. See what changed.
notification.PLACE_NARRATION_FAILED: Narration for {placeName} couldn't be made. We're looking into it.
notification.SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_FAILED: Your last payment didn't go through. Update your card in Plan and billing.
notification.ENTITLEMENTS_REDUCED: Your plan changed, so some features are off. See Plan and billing.
notification.VOUCHER_OFFER_APPROVED: Your voucher offer for {placeName} was approved.
notification.VOUCHER_OFFER_REJECTED: Your voucher offer for {placeName} wasn't approved. See the note.
notification.VOUCHER_CODE_GUESSING_SUSPE: Many wrong voucher codes were tried at {placeName}. Check who is redeeming there.
notification.PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_ACTION_REQUI: Your payout account needs attention before you can be paid. Open Plan and billing.
notification.ACCOUNT_RECOVERY_PENDING: Someone asked to move your account to a new email. If it wasn't you, stop it now.
notification.ACCOUNT_RECOVERY_COMPLETED: Your account's email was changed through account recovery.
account.title: Account
account.lead: Your name, your email and how you sign in.
account.name: Name
account.resent: We sent a new link to {email}.
account.staffNote: Staff accounts sign in with email and password only.
account.signOutEverywhereBody: Every browser and phone signed in to this account, this one included.
account.signOutEverywhereConfirm: Every browser and phone signed in to this account, this one included, will be signed out.
account.emailLead: We'll send a link to the new address. Your email changes only when you open it.
account.emailSent: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to finish the change.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
account.removeGoogleBody: You'll sign in with your email and password from now on. Every other session will be signed out; this one stays signed in.
state.noPermissionBody: {page} needs a permission your account doesn't have. Ask an admin if you need it.
state.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
state.pageNotFoundBody: Check the address, or start from Home.
banner.apiDown: Wayfare can't reach its servers. Pages keep what they showed, and we'll keep trying.
banner.offline: You're offline. Pages keep what they showed; saving needs a connection.
banner.bounced: Mail can't reach {email}, so links and notices won't arrive. Check the address, or change it.
terms.title: Updated terms
terms.heading: We've updated our terms
terms.body: The Terms of service and the Privacy policy changed. Read what changed, then accept them to keep using your account.
places.title: Places
places.lead: Every place tourists can find, and the ones on their way.
places.emptyBody: Places appear here once an owner's submission is approved, or when you create one.
places.noResultsBody: Try fewer filters, or clear them to see every place.
submissions.title: My submissions
submissions.lead: Changes you sent for review, newest first.
form.lead: Fields marked * are required. Changes go live once you save.
form.attention: {count, plural, one {One field needs attention.} =2 {Two fields need attention.} other {# fields need attention.}} Nothing was saved.
issue.phone: Use a full phone number, like 028 3829 7943.
issue.email: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
issue.passwordShort: Too short: {count} characters. Use at least {minimum}.
leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to {name} will be lost.
reauth.title: Sign in to save your changes
reauth.body: Your session ended. Sign in again and your changes to {name} are saved; nothing on this page is lost.
reauth.otherNote: Signing in as someone else leaves this form without saving.
dialog.unpublishBody: Tourists stop seeing it on the map and in Explore, and its owner is told. You can publish it again.
dialog.deleteBody: It disappears for tourists and for its owner, and its QR stickers stop working. This can't be undone.
dialog.rejectBody: The place stays as it is now. The owner can change it and send it again.
dialog.noteHelp: {owner} sees this note with the decision. At least 10 characters.
toast.failedBody: Something went wrong on our side. Request ID {id}
patterns.title: Page patterns
patterns.lead: Development only: the list, detail and form pages, the dialogs and the toasts, with sample places.
reset.done: Your password is saved. Sign in with it.
recovery.done: Your account is recovered. Sign in with your new password.
place.name: Name
place.photoCount: {count} of 8 photos · the first is the cover
place.belongsTo: {name} belongs to {owner}. Changes you save here are applied at once, and {owner} is told what changed.
place.editorialRadius: {m} m — tourists hear it within about {comparison}
place.editorialPriority: {p} of 100 — when places overlap, the higher one plays first
place.editorialOnly: Set by Wayfare's editors only; owners never see or change these.
narration.title: Narration
placeForm.newLead: An Editorial Place: a landmark, a temple, a viewpoint — with no owner. Write it in Vietnamese; Wayfare translates it and records the audio.
placeForm.name: Name, in Vietnamese
placeForm.nameHelp: As it is known locally. Wayfare translates it for each language.
placeForm.descriptionHelp: Read aloud in every language. {min} to {max} characters (now {count}).
placeForm.mapHelp: Drag the map to put the pin on the entrance. Tourists are guided to this point.
placeForm.noMap: This area has no published map yet: enter the coordinates.
placeForm.mapLabel: Map: drag to move the pin
placeForm.photoHelp: {count} of 8 · drag to reorder · the first is the cover. JPEG, PNG or WebP under 5 MB.
placeForm.dropPhoto: Drop a photo here, or browse
placeForm.midnight: Closing after midnight counts as the same night.
placeForm.editorialLead: Only Wayfare's editors set these. They decide when a passer-by hears the place.
placeForm.createNote: Requesting activation makes the English text and audio now; it goes live by itself once they are ready.
placeForm.ownerTold: {name} belongs to {owner}, who is told what you change.
placeForm.textWarning: You changed the description. When you save, {name} leaves the map until its new English audio is ready — usually under a minute. Photos, hours and the menu never do that.
placeForm.staleBody: Someone changed {name} while you were editing. Reload to see their version; your changes are kept below.
placeForm.attention: {count, plural, one {One thing needs attention.} =2 {Two things need attention.} =3 {Three things need attention.} other {# things need attention.}} Nothing was created.
placeForm.attentionSaved: {count, plural, one {One thing needs attention.} other {# things need attention.}} Nothing was saved.
placeForm.tooManyPhotos: A place has at most 8 photos. Remove one to add another.
error.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That photo is {size} MB. Use one under 5 MB.
error.UPLOAD_TYPE_MISMATCH: That file isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
error.UPLOAD_NOT_READY: That photo didn't finish uploading. Add it again.
error.CATEGORY_NOT_APPLICABLE: That category is for venues with an owner. Choose another.
error.LOCATION_OUTSIDE_AREAS: The pin is outside every area Wayfare covers. Move it into one.
editorial.radiusHelp: Tourists walking by hear it once they are within {m} m — about {comparison} on a city street. Keep it small where places sit close together.
editorial.circle: The circle is {m} m around the pin ({lat}, {lng}).
editorial.priorityHelp: When a tourist is inside two places' circles at once, the higher priority plays first. 50 is ordinary; save 80 and above for landmarks people come for.
editorial.never: Saving these never takes the place off the map.
gate.title: Not live yet — activation requested
gate.enAudio: English audio — waits for the text
gate.byItself: It goes live by itself as soon as both are ready — you don't need to come back.
gate.liveBody: {name} is on the map for tourists.
error.AREA_INACTIVE: Its area, {area}, is switched off, so it can't go live. Turn the area on first.
deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.bodyEditorial: Tourists stop seeing it on the map and in Explore; its QR stickers say it isn't available. You can activate it again.
deactivate.bodyVenue: Tourists stop seeing it on the map and in Explore. {owner} is told straight away that Wayfare hid it, so this can't be undone from here — activating it again tells them too.
deactivate.reasonHelp: Only staff see this, in the history.
deactivate.reasonHelpVenue: Only staff see the reason, in the history. {owner} sees that the venue was hidden, and can write to support.
deactivate.toldVenue: {owner} has been told. To show it again, use Activate.
delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: It disappears for tourists, and its QR stickers stop working. You can restore it later from Places (Include deleted).
delete.doneBody: {name} is off the map; its stickers stopped working.
error.PLACE_HAS_LIVE_VOUCHERS: It has vouchers that haven't been used. Wait until they are used or expire.
delete.billingDown: Billing can't confirm the Place can be deleted right now, so nothing was deleted. Try again in a few minutes.
qr.title: QR sticker
qr.body: Scanning it opens this place in Wayfare, or on the web without the app. The code printed under it is {code} — it never changes.
qr.note: Prints well from 5 × 5 cm. Code {code} — the same on every sticker for this place, for good.
submissions.adminLead: Owners' proposed changes, oldest first. Approving one sets its editorial values.
submissions.emptyBody: Owners' changes appear here as they send them.
submission.counts: {changed, plural, one {# field changes} other {# fields change}} · {same} stay the same
submission.descriptionNote: Changing the description makes new audio in every language; the place leaves the map for about a minute once approved.
submission.createNote: A new venue has no live place to compare with: this is the proposal as {owner} wrote it. Approving creates it, and it goes live once its English audio is ready.
submission.editorialLead: Set by you, never by the owner. They take effect on approval.
submission.categoryHelp: Change it only if the owner chose one that doesn't fit.
conflict.title: Changed since this was sent: {fields}
conflict.body: {who} changed the {field} {when}, after {owner} sent this. Approving would replace the {field} as it is now with {owner}'s. Compare them below, then confirm beside Approve.
conflict.ack: I've seen that the {field} changed since this was sent, and {owner}'s replace them.
approve.title: Approve the changes to {name}?
approve.next: {name} goes to Processing, then live again once its new audio is ready — usually under a minute.
approve.noteOwnerHelp: Optional. {owner} sees it with the decision.
reject.title: Reject the changes to {name}?
reject.body: {name} stays as it is now. {owner} can change the submission and send it again.
reject.noteHelp: {owner} sees this with the decision. At least 10 characters.
decided.title: Already decided
decided.body: Someone decided this submission already, so nothing was changed. Back to the queue for the next one.
error.PLACE_LIMIT_REACHED: {owner}'s plan doesn't allow another venue. Reject it with a note asking them to change plans or remove a venue.
error.PHOTO_LIMIT_REACHED: This has more photos than {owner}'s plan allows. Reject it with a note asking them to send fewer.
error.MENU_LIMIT_REACHED: The menu has more dishes than {owner}'s plan allows. Reject it with a note asking them to send fewer.
error.ENTITLEMENTS_UNAVAILABLE: Billing can't confirm {owner}'s plan right now, so nothing was approved. Try again in a few minutes.
approve.identityDown: Wayfare can't check {owner}'s account right now, so nothing was approved. Try again in a few minutes.
approve.outsideAreas: The venue's pin is outside every area Wayfare covers now. Reject it with a note asking them to check the location.
approve.categoryOverride: That category isn't for venues. Choose another, or keep the one the owner chose.
approve.photoGone: A photo in this submission is no longer available. Reject it with a note asking them to add it again.
approve.conflict: Someone changed this place since it was sent. Compare the fields, tick the box, then approve.
approve.ownerNotVerified: {owner} is no longer a verified owner, so this can't be approved. Reject it with a note instead.
registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.lead: People asking to join as venue owners, oldest pending first.
registrations.search: Search a business or a contact
registrations.emptyBody: New venue owners' applications appear here.
registration.revealNote: Revealing the full number is recorded in the audit log with your name and reason.
reveal.title: Reveal the full national ID?
reveal.body: It is shown once, to you, and never kept on the page. You can reveal a few numbers an hour.
reveal.placeholder: Checking it against the registration certificate
reveal.whyHelp: Recorded with your name in the audit log. At least 10 characters, and never the number itself.
reveal.shownOnce: Shown once, to you. It disappears when you hide it or leave the page, and is never kept on it; revealing it again is recorded again.
reveal.redactedBody: The full number, the phone and the note were removed for good.
reveal.rateLimited: You've revealed several numbers this hour. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
regApprove.title: Approve {name}?
regApprove.body: {applicant} becomes a venue owner: they can add venues and choose a plan.
regApprove.told: They are emailed, and see it in the console.
regReject.title: Reject {name}?
regReject.noteHelp: Sent with the decision. At least 10 characters.
regReject.body: {applicant} is told why, and can apply again.
ownApp.title: Your own application
ownApp.body: This is your own application, so another reviewer decides it. You can read it, but not approve or reject it.
regDecided.body: This application isn't waiting any more: {reason}.
jobs.title: Narration jobs
jobs.lead: Translations and audio being made, newest first. Rows update as jobs move.
jobs.emptyBody: Jobs appear here as places are written, edited and approved.
job.startedLine: {trigger} · started {time} · {what} · {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}
job.waiting: Waiting for a speech provider: none could be reached since {time}. Next try at {next} (in {minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}}). It keeps trying for 24 hours — this is not stuck.
job.liveNote: Live: each task's stage and status move as they change. A waiting task says when it tries again.
job.cancelBody: Languages already finished keep their new audio. The rest won't be made; tourists keep what they have now. You can regenerate later.
job.notActive: That job has already {state}. The row now shows where it is.
regen.title: Regenerate narration
regen.textOnly: Text only (keeps the audio until it is redone)
regen.note: This replaces any job still running for the place. Tourists keep the current audio until the new one is ready.
error.LOCALIZATION_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: That place no longer exists, so there is nothing to regenerate.
providers.title: Providers
providers.lead: Which translation and speech providers answer, and which is serving now.
providers.whyTitle: Why everything is on the paid provider today
providers.whyBody: {role} is on the next provider in the order, because {name} stopped answering. It goes back by itself once {name} answers again.
providers.fallback: Used when the one before fails
providers.process: Health is counted by each narration process; this page shows the one that answered, and another can briefly differ.
submissions.menuDishes: menu ({count, plural, one {# dish} other {# dishes}})
placeForm.editNote: Saved changes are live at once (text after its audio).
placeForm.editLead: Fields marked * are required. Text changes are read aloud again in every language.
place.circleCaption: The circle is {m} m around the pin (about {comparison}).
job.pausedLine: Paused — tasks already running finished; the rest wait.
required.name: Give it a name.
reveal.redactedOn: Redacted on {date}, 180 days after the decision.
job.failedTranslation: Translation failed after {tries, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}}: {error}. Retry, or check the Vietnamese text for unusual characters.
job.failedAudio: The audio failed after {tries, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}}: {error}. Retry; tourists keep the text meanwhile.
providers.whyBodySince: {role} is on the next provider in the order since {time}, because {name} stopped answering. It goes back by itself once {name} answers again.
categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: What a Place can be. Each name comes from the app's strings, so a new code is named in the next release.
categories.noName: No name yet — it comes with the next release.
categories.newLead: Its name in each language comes with the next release of the app; until then the code is shown.
categories.codeHelp: Upper case and underscores, like NIGHT_MARKET. It can't be changed later.
categories.codeFixed: A code can't be changed. A wrong one is fixed by a new category.
categories.appliesHelp: Owners only see categories for Venues.
categories.iconNew: A new code shows a map pin until a release gives it its own icon, as it gives its name.
categories.iconDrawn: The app draws this icon for {code}.
categories.orderHelp: Lower comes first in pickers and filters.
categories.codeTaken: {code} is already a category. Codes are never reused.
categories.deactivateBody: It leaves the pickers and the filters. The {count} Places that have it keep it, and owners can't choose it for new submissions.
categories.deactivatedBody: It no longer appears in pickers.
areas.title: Areas and map packs
areas.lead: Where Wayfare works. Each area has a boundary Places must lie in, and the offline map pack tourists download.
areas.boundaryLine: {points} points · centre {lat}, {lng} · opens at zoom {zoom} · {places} Places inside
areas.packsLead: Built and uploaded by the tiles build. Publishing a version offers it to tourists and retires the one before.
areas.activateBody: Tourists see the area and its published map pack.
areas.deactivateBody: Tourists stop seeing the area and its map pack.
areas.liveBody: It still has {live} live Places ({active} active, {processing} processing). Deactivate or move them first; an area with live Places stays on tourists' maps.
packs.kept: Kept 30 days for downloads in progress
packs.empty: No map pack yet. The tiles build registers one.
packs.publishBody: Tourists are offered version {version} the next time they open the map or check for updates. Version {old} is retired, and its files are kept 30 days so downloads in progress finish.
packs.publishBodyFirst: Tourists are offered version {version} the next time they open the map or check for updates.
packs.publishedBody: Tourists in {area} get it on their next update.
packs.alreadyPUBLISHED: Version {version} is already published. The table now shows where it is.
packs.alreadyRETIRED: Version {version} is already retired. The table now shows where it is.
areaForm.lead: Draw the boundary on the map, or paste it as GeoJSON. Places must lie inside it, and areas can't overlap.
areaForm.codeHelp: Lower case with dashes. It can't be changed: offline packs and phones store it.
areaForm.name: Name, in Vietnamese
areaForm.nameHelp: Other languages come from the app's strings with the next release.
areaForm.keys: With the map focused: Tab moves between points, the arrow keys move the selected one, Delete removes it, Enter adds one after it. Paste GeoJSON is the same in text.
areaForm.centreHelp: Where the map opens. Set from the boundary's middle; drag the crosshair to change it.
areaForm.zoomHelp: 10 shows the whole city, 18 a single street.
areaForm.hidden: A new area is hidden from tourists until it has a published map pack and you activate it.
areaForm.codeTaken: {code} is already an area. Codes are never reused.
areaForm.centreInvalid: Write the centre as latitude, longitude, inside the boundary.
areaForm.overlapBody: Areas can't overlap. Move the points inside the dashed edge of {area} ({code}), then save again.
areaForm.outsideBody: {names} lie outside the new boundary. Widen it, or move those Places first.
geojson.title: Paste a boundary
geojson.help: One polygon, at most 500 points, longitude before latitude. It replaces the drawn boundary.
geojson.tooMany: A boundary has at most 500 points.
history.seeAll: See all in the audit log
pron.title: Pronunciation
pron.lead: How the voices say Vietnamese names inside other languages. Saving an entry makes every narration that holds the term again, slowly, behind tourists' own requests.
pron.emptyBody: Add one when a voice says a Vietnamese name wrong.
pronForm.lead: An entry tells the voice how to say a Vietnamese name when it appears in another language.
pronForm.termHelp: As written, with its marks: Bến Thành and Ben Thanh are different entries.
pronForm.languageHelp: All languages, or one when only that voice says it wrong.
pronForm.sayAlias: An alias — spelled the way the voice should read it
pronForm.sayPhoneme: A phoneme string, in IPA or X-SAMPA
pronForm.aliasHelp: The voice reads this in place of the term. Up to 255 characters.
pronForm.noteHelp: Optional. For other staff; tourists never see it. Up to 255 characters.
pronForm.saveNote: Saving makes every narration that holds the term again, a few at a time, so tourists' own requests come first.
pronForm.savedBody: Narrations that hold {term} are being made again, a few at a time.
pronForm.hearLead: Plays a sample with this entry applied. Nothing is saved or stored.
pronForm.sampleHelp: Up to {max} characters, in that language.
pronForm.noVoice: {language} has no voice yet, so there is nothing to hear.
pronForm.tooMany: That's a lot of previews in a short time. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
pronForm.sampleText: {term} is worth the walk, and the stalls around it sell almost everything.
pronForm.fillFirst: Write the term and how to say it first.
pronDelete.title: Delete the entry for {term}?
pronDelete.body: Narrations that hold {term} are made again without it, a few at a time. This can't be undone; to bring it back, add the entry again.
corr.title: Translation corrections
corr.lead: Fix a machine translation of a Place, a tour or a dish. Vietnamese is edited on the Place itself.
corr.find: Find a Place by name or code
corr.emptyBody: Find a Place above to correct one of its translations.
corr.supersededLine: The Vietnamese changed since this correction; tourists hear the machine text until you review it.
corrEdit.title: Correct the {language}
corrEdit.name: Name
corrEdit.descriptionHelp: Read aloud as written. 1 to {max} characters (now {count}).
corrEdit.together: Tourists keep the current {language} words and audio until the corrected audio is ready; then both change together.
corrEdit.savedBody: The new audio is being made; tourists get both together.
corrEdit.changedTitle: The Vietnamese changed while you were editing
corrEdit.changedBody: Someone saved the Place a moment ago. Your text is kept: reload the Vietnamese, check it, then save again.
corrEdit.staleTitle: This correction is out of date
corrEdit.staleBody: The Vietnamese changed since this correction. Check the correction against the new text and save it, or go back to the machine text.
corrEdit.revertTitle: Go back to the machine translation for {language}?
corrEdit.revertBody: Your correction stops being used. Tourists keep the corrected words and audio until the machine version's audio is ready; then both change together.
corrEdit.unavailable: That {target} no longer exists, so there is nothing to correct.
permission.user.lock: Lock and unlock accounts, and revoke their sessions.
permission.place.read: View every Place, in any status.
permission.place.editorial.update: Set a Place's trigger radius and narration priority.
permission.map_pack.manage: Register and publish offline map packs.
permission.narration.job.manage: Start, pause, resume, cancel and retry synthesis jobs.
permission.billing.entitlement.override: Override and unpin an owner's entitlements.
permission.billing.event.read: View and replay Stripe webhook events.
auditAction.PLACE_REACTIVATED: Place shown again by its owner
users.title: Users and roles
users.lead: Everyone with an account: tourists who signed in, owners and staff.
users.noResultsBody: Try another name, email or filter.
user.levelTitle: You can read this account, not change it
user.levelBody: {name} holds permissions you don't, so this page is read-only for you: {codes}.
staff.title: New staff account
staff.name: Name
staff.emailHelp: A link to choose a password goes here. It works for 72 hours; after that, Forgot password still works.
staff.rolesHelp: Super admin is never given from the console. You can give only what you hold yourself.
staff.createdBody: A link to choose a password is on its way to {email}.
staff.emailTaken: That address is already used by an account, or kept for an email change being undone.
staff.notAssignable: Super admin can't be given from the console.
rolesDialog.title: Roles of {name}
rolesDialog.lead: A change applies at their next refresh, within minutes; nobody is signed out.
rolesDialog.takeOffOnly: can be taken off, not given here
rolesDialog.beyond: It gives permissions you don't hold.
rolesDialog.deniedBody: You can't give what you don't have: {codes}. Ask a super admin.
rolesDialog.lastTitle: {name} is the only active super admin
rolesDialog.lastBody: The console needs at least one. Make another account a super admin from the bootstrap script first.
lock.title: Lock {name}?
lock.reasonHelp: Staff see it in the history. Up to 255 characters.
lock.untilHelp: Optional, at most a year away. Empty: until someone unlocks it.
lock.untilFar: Choose a date within a year.
lock.self: You can't lock your own account.
unlock.title: Unlock {name}?
deactivateUser.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivateUser.body: They are signed out and can't sign in. You can restore the account later.
deactivateUser.reasonHelp: Kept in the audit log. Up to 500 characters.
deactivateUser.vouchersBody: {name} has {issued} vouchers sold and not used yet, and {checkouts} checkout in progress. Deactivating stops redemption, so the buyers must be refunded.
deactivateUser.refund: Refund the {issued} unused vouchers and cancel the checkout
restoreUser.title: Restore {name}?
signOutAll.title: Sign {name} out everywhere?
signOutAll.body: Every browser and phone signed in to this account is signed out within a minute. Their password and Google stay as they are.
deliveries.title: Email deliveries
deliveries.lead: What was sent to {name} and what happened to it. Bodies and links are never kept.
deliveries.checkLead: When someone says "I never got it", check the address they think it went to. You're told only whether it matches; each check is recorded.
deliveries.matches: Matches: the deliveries above went to {email}.
deliveries.noMatch: Doesn't match: no delivery went to {email}.
deliveries.empty: Nothing has been sent to this account.
rec.title: Recoveries
rec.lead: Owners who lost their email address, moved to a new one by two people and a 72-hour hold. Cases are opened from an owner's page.
rec.emptyBody: Cases are opened from an owner's page.
recOpen.title: Open a recovery for {name}
recOpen.addressHelp: The address the owner gave support. It can't already belong to an account.
recOpen.check.PHONE_CALLBACK: A call back to the phone number on file
recOpen.check.BUSINESS_DETAILS_MATCH: The business details match the registration
recOpen.check.BILLING_KNOWLEDGE: They know their billing (plan, last payment)
recOpen.checksHelp: At least two, the call back among them. Only that a check passed is kept — never the number, card digits or amounts.
recOpen.referenceHelp: The ticket where the owner asked.
recOpen.nothingSent: Nothing is sent to {name} yet. The owner hears when someone else approves and the 72-hour hold starts.
recOpen.doneBody: A super admin approves it next.
recOpen.tooFew: Tick at least two checks, the call back among them.
recOpen.taken: That address already belongs to an account.
recOpen.liveTitle: A case is already open for {name}
recOpen.liveBody: Opened {date} by {who}, {status}. Open that case instead.
recOpen.notOwner: Recoveries are only for owners. {name} isn't one.
recPage.title: Recovery for {name}
recPage.approvedNext: Approved by someone other than the opener
recPage.holdNote: The owner was told at their current address and in the app, and can cancel
recPage.holdNextNote: Starts when approved; the owner is told everywhere and can cancel
recPage.linkSent: Link sent to the new address
recPage.completedNext: The owner sets the address and a new password
recPage.cancelledNote: From the notice at their current address. Nothing changed on the account.
recPage.ownCaseBody: Someone else approves it: a second person keeps one account from being taken over by one mistake.
recApprove.title: Approve the recovery for {name}?
recApprove.body: A 72-hour hold starts now. {name} is told at their current address and in the app, and can cancel. When the hold ends, a link to {email} lets them set it and a new password. The case expires on {date}.
recReject.title: Reject the recovery for {name}?
recReject.whyHelp: Kept with the case; the owner is told it was rejected, not why. Up to {max} characters.
recDecide.already: This case is already {status}. The page now shows where it is.
roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: What each kind of account may do. System roles are fixed in code; custom roles are made from the same permissions.
role.facts: {code} · held by {held} · {count, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
role.seeded: a seeded default you may edit
roleForm.name: Name
roleForm.nameHelp: Its code is made from the name and never changes.
roleForm.permissionsLead: You can give only what you hold yourself; the rest is shown but can't be ticked.
roleForm.notYours: You don't hold this, so you can't give it.
roleForm.note: People holding the role get the change at their next refresh, within minutes.
roleForm.retiredCode: {code} is retired and can't be given.
roleForm.tooWideBody: A change to its permissions can reach at most {limit} accounts at once. Make a new role with the change and move people to it in groups.
roleDelete.title: Delete {role}?
roleDelete.inUseBody: {count} accounts hold it, deactivated ones included. Take it off them first; then it can be deleted.
roleDelete.body: Nobody holds it. This can't be undone; its code isn't reused.
auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.lead: What changed, who did it and when, newest first. Read up to 93 days at a time.
auditLog.noDetails: Nothing more is kept for this.
auditLog.backwards: The start comes before the end.
auditLog.tooLongBody: The log is read 93 days at a time. Narrow the dates to see entries.
auditLog.emptyBody: Try other dates or clear the filters.
stuck.title: Needs a look
stuck.lead: {count, plural, one {# Place has} other {# Places have}} been in Processing for over an hour with nothing making their audio. They won't move by themselves.
stuck.alertBody: It has been in Processing {since} and nothing is making its audio: {why}. Tourists don't see it until it's narrated.
recReject.whyPlaceholder: For example: the call back reached someone who didn't know the business.
lock.untilInvalid: Write the day, month and year, like 30 Oct 2026.
areaForm.codeFixed: A code can't be changed. A wrong one is fixed by a new area.
roleDesc.SUPER_ADMIN: Every permission, including who can do what. Defined in code.
roleDesc.ADMIN: Everything except changing who can do what, who controls an account, or moving money. Defined in code.
roleDesc.VENUE_OWNER: Runs their own Venues in the owner portal. Defined in code.
roleDesc.USER: Given when someone signs up in the app; a tourist's features need no permission. Defined in code.
roleDesc.CONTENT_MODERATOR: Reviews submissions and registrations, edits Places, the dictionary and translations.
placeForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Tiệm bánh mì nổi tiếng từ năm 1989, nhân pa-tê và chả lụa.
placeForm.addressPlaceholder: 26 Lê Thị Riêng, Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1
placeForm.altTextPlaceholder: The front of the shop, seen from the street
placeDeactivate.reasonPlaceholder: For example: scaffolding covers the front until December.
decision.ownerNotePlaceholder: For example: the new photos show a different shopfront.
decision.applicantNotePlaceholder: For example: the registration number doesn't match the certificate.
decision.internalNotePlaceholder: For example: checked the hours by phone.
reveal.whyPlaceholder: Checking it against the registration certificate
pattern.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the photos show a different shopfront.
pronForm.notePlaceholder: For example: the market and the ward
lock.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the owner reports a stolen phone.
deactivateUser.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the stall closed in September.
roleForm.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: reviews Vĩnh Khánh's night-market stalls.
notification.ENTITLEMENTS_RAISED: Your plan now gives you more. See Plan and billing.
grants.autoOn: On — its Venues play when a tourist walks near
grants.autoOff: Off — a Venue's story plays only when a tourist taps it
grants.scope.EXTENDED: The launch languages and the long tail
plans.title: Plans
plans.lead: What an owner's subscription grants. Editing a plan changes nobody until you apply it.
plans.grantsLead: Every grant is capped by the platform: a plan narrows what the platform allows, never widens it.
plans.pricesLead: Prices are Stripe's: each is registered by its ID, and its amount is read from Stripe. US dollars only.
plans.noPrices: No price yet: the plan is assigned until its first price is registered.
plans.applyBody: This writes the plan's grants onto every subscriber who isn't pinned.
plans.applyPinned: pinned accounts are skipped — their off-catalogue grants stay
plans.applyPlaces: Places would be taken off the map: their owners are over the new Places limit
plans.applyPlacesUnknown: Places that would leave the map: not known
plans.applyDryRun: A dry run: nothing has changed yet. Applying tells each owner whose grants shrink.
plans.applyNothing: No accounts change: every subscriber already has {plan}'s grants.
plans.retireBody: A retired plan leaves the catalogue for good; its code can be used again.
plans.retireRefusedBody: {plan} has {n} subscribers, deactivated accounts included. Move them to another plan in Stripe first; a plan with no one on it can be retired.
plans.retireNobody: Nobody is on it. A retired plan leaves the catalogue for good and can't be brought back; its code can be used again.
price.title: Register a price for {plan}
price.idHelp: From Stripe's dashboard: Products → {plan} → the price. The amount comes from Stripe; it is never typed here.
price.replacesMonthly: It replaces the monthly price in force, {amount}. Owners already subscribed keep paying {amount} until they change their plan; new subscriptions use {new}.
price.replacesYearly: It replaces the yearly price in force, {amount}. Owners already subscribed keep paying {amount} until they change their plan; new subscriptions use {new}.
price.notFound: Stripe has no active price with this ID.
price.currency: That price isn't in US dollars. Plans are sold in US dollars only.
price.interval: That price renews every {interval}; choose that interval.
price.product: That price belongs to another Stripe product, not {plan}'s.
price.amount: That price has no fixed amount.
price.assigned: {plan} is assigned, not sold, so it has no prices.
price.noAnswer: Stripe didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
planForm.lead: A plan states every grant; none has a default. It is assigned by staff until its first Stripe price is registered; from then on it is sold through Stripe.
planForm.codeHelp: Upper case and underscores. It can't be changed later.
planForm.codeShape: Upper case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
planForm.codeFixed: A code can't be changed. A wrong one is fixed by a new plan.
planForm.codeTaken: {code} is already a plan. A live plan's code is never reused.
planForm.name: Name
planForm.nameHelp: Shown to owners on the pricing page and in Plan and billing.
planForm.orderHelp: Lower comes first on the pricing page.
planForm.grantsLead: Every grant is required, and each is capped by the platform: a plan can narrow what the platform allows, never widen it.
planForm.boostHelp: Sponsored placement in lists and on the map — never in narration.
planForm.autoHelp: Editorial Places always narrate. Money never buys narration: this only lets a Venue's own story start by itself, under the same priority and one-Venue-in-ten-minutes rules.
planForm.sellVouchers: Owners on this plan can sell vouchers
planForm.commissionHelp: 0 to {max}. Shown only when the plan sells vouchers; the platform keeps it from each sale.
planForm.saveNote: Saving changes no subscriber until you apply the plan.
planForm.editNote: Saving changes the catalogue only. {name}'s {n} subscribers keep their grants until you apply the plan.
planForm.attention: {n, plural, one {# field needs attention} other {# fields need attention}}
planForm.attentionBody: {n, plural, one {Fix the field marked below, then create the plan again.} other {Fix the # fields marked below, then create the plan again.}}
planForm.attentionBodyEdit: {n, plural, one {Fix the field marked below, then save again.} other {Fix the # fields marked below, then save again.}}
accounts.title: Billing accounts
accounts.lead: Each owner's subscription as Stripe reports it, and the grants in force.
accounts.emptyBody: An account opens when an owner is verified.
account.noCustomer: None yet: one is made at the first checkout
account.grantsLead: In force, beside the plan's. They match unless the account is pinned or the subscription doesn't grant its plan.
account.grantsPinned: Pinned: these grants survive renewals until someone unpins the account. An override is marked.
account.pastDueBody: Stripe is retrying the card. {plan}'s grants stay while it does; if the retries run out, Free's apply and nothing is deleted. {name} sees a banner and was emailed.
account.cancelledBody: The subscription ended, so Free's grants apply. Nothing was deleted: Places over Free's limit were taken off the map, and come back if the owner subscribes again.
account.pinnedBody: Renewals keep these grants until someone unpins the account.
account.pinnedPlainBody: Renewals keep its grants until someone unpins it.
account.unpinBody: Its grants return at once to {plan}'s, by today's status ({status}):
account.unpinPlaces: {n} Places would be taken off the map. {name} is told what changed, whether a limit goes up or down.
account.toldWhatChanged: {name} is told what changed, whether a limit goes up or down.
account.unpinSame: The grants stay as they are: they already match the plan.
account.unpinReasonHelp: Kept in the audit log. Up to 500 characters.
account.unpinReasonExample: For example: the pilot ended; back to the plan.
grantForm.title: Change {name}'s grants
grantForm.lead: An off-catalogue grant, outside what {plan} gives. It pins the account.
grantForm.pins: Saving pins the account: Stripe's renewals keep updating the subscription but leave these grants alone, until someone unpins it.
grantForm.reasonHelp: Kept with the account and in the audit log. Up to 500 characters.
grantForm.reasonExample: For example: a partner pilot, agreed until March.
grantForm.noChanges: Nothing yet: every grant is as it is now.
grantForm.effect: Takes effect at once, and {name} is told what changed.
events.title: Stripe events
events.lead: Every webhook Stripe sent, as it arrived, and what was done with it. Skipped as stale is normal: a newer event got there first.
events.emptyBody: Stripe hasn't sent a webhook yet.
events.payloadLead: As Stripe sent it. It holds the customer's email, so only billing.event.read sees it.
events.testOnLive: A test-mode event on the live endpoint
events.testOnLiveBody: It was recorded and ignored: nothing changed. Test events belong to the test endpoint; this one was probably sent from Stripe's test dashboard.
events.liveOnTest: A live event on the test stack
events.liveOnTestBody: It was recorded and ignored: nothing changed. Live events belong to the live endpoint.
events.replayBody: It runs again with the same guards. If a newer event has already set this subscription, it is skipped as stale and nothing changes.
events.replayedStaleBody: A newer event had already set this subscription, so nothing changed.
events.replayedPending: Replayed: still waiting to be processed
events.notFailed: Only a failed event can be replayed; this one is {status}.
grants.autoNote: Money never buys narration: this only lets a Venue's own story start by itself.
plans.applyPlacesNone: No Places would leave the map
grantForm.attentionBody: {n, plural, one {Fix the field marked below, then save and pin again.} other {Fix the # fields marked below, then save and pin again.}}
signUp.title: Register your venue
signUp.lead: Create an account first. Then verify your email and apply: an admin reviews every application.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.nameHelp: Optional. Shown to Wayfare staff with your application.
signUp.termsRequired: Agree to the terms to create an account.
signUp.takenTitle: This address already has a Wayfare account
signUp.takenBody: Sign in with it, or use another address.
signUp.takenField: That address already has an account.
checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your address; then you can apply.
checkEmail.help: It can take a minute. Look in spam too. The link works for 24 hours.
checkEmail.verifyBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it, then come back here to apply.
gLink.title: Link Google to your account
gLink.body: {email} already has a Wayfare account. Enter its password once; after that, Continue with Google signs you in.
gLink.note: Your password stays: you can sign in either way.
gLink.expired: That took too long. Continue with Google again.
gLink.notLinked: You're signed in, but Google isn't linked yet: that took too long. Link it from your account page.
apply.title: Apply to list your venue
apply.lead: Step 3 of 3. An admin reviews every application; you'll hear in the bell. Until then, the portal shows only this application.
apply.businessNameHelp: As tourists should see it, with its accents.
apply.regNoHelp: Optional. On your business registration certificate, if you have one.
apply.contactPhoneHelp: An admin may call to check the application.
apply.nationalIdHelp: The 12 digits on your citizen identity card.
apply.nationalIdAgain: Type it again: Wayfare never shows it back. The 12 digits on your citizen identity card.
apply.nationalIdDigits: A national ID has 12 digits; this has {n}.
apply.whyTitle: Why we ask, and how it is kept
apply.whyBody: Wayfare asks so that only the real owner of a business can speak for it. The number is encrypted the moment you send it. Staff see only its last four digits; if one of them needs the whole number to check your application, that is recorded. It is erased 180 days after the decision.
apply.noteHelp: Optional. Anything that helps us check your application. Up to 1000 characters.
apply.notePlaceholder: e.g. We have run this stall since 2015; the shop sign says "Ốc Ngọc".
apply.summary1: You list only businesses you own or run, and keep their details true.
apply.summary2: Wayfare decides how stories are told and when they play. Money never buys narration: a plan only lets a Venue's own story start by itself.
apply.summary3: Photos you send are yours to share; Wayfare may show them in the app.
apply.accept: I have read the owner agreement and accept it
apply.acceptRequired: Accept the owner agreement to send the application.
apply.checked: Your answers are checked by Wayfare staff. You can withdraw the application while it waits.
apply.again: Your last answers are filled in; change what the note asked for. Type the national ID again: Wayfare never shows it back.
apply.fixTitle: {n, plural, one {# thing needs} other {# things need}} attention
apply.fixBody: Fix the {n, plural, one {thing} other {# things}} marked below, then send again.
apply.outdatedTitle: The owner agreement has a new version
apply.outdatedBody: It changed while you were filling this in. Read version {version} and accept it again; your answers are kept.
apply.pending: You already have an application waiting. You can withdraw it and send a new one.
apply.alreadyOwner: Your account is already an owner.
myReg.title: Your registration
myReg.lead: Apply to list your venue on Wayfare. An admin reviews every application.
myReg.reviewsNote: You'll hear by email and in the bell
myReg.idNote: Wayfare never shows your national ID back; only its last four digits.
myReg.withdrawBody: Wayfare stops reviewing it. You can apply again at any time; your answers are kept, except the national ID, which you type again.
myReg.withdrewBody: On {date}. Nothing was decided; apply again whenever you are ready.
myReg.notYet: You haven't applied yet. Tell us about your business: an admin reviews every application.
welcome.title: Welcome to Wayfare
welcome.lead: Your registration is approved. This is your portal.
welcome.free: You're on Free: one venue, whose story plays when a tourist taps it, in Vietnamese and English.
welcome.add: Add your venue. An admin checks it before it's public.
welcome.qr: Once it's live, print its QR sticker for your door or menu.
welcome.plans: When you want more, see the plans: more venues, and stories that start by themselves.
venue.processingLine: Live once its audio is ready
venues.title: My venues
venues.lead: Each venue as tourists find it, and what is waiting for review.
venues.used: {used} of {max, plural, one {# place} other {# places}} used
venues.newWaiting: {n, plural, one {# new venue, {name}, is} other {# new venues, {name}, are}} waiting for review and {n, plural, one {holds a place} other {hold places}}.
venues.empty: No venues yet. Add your venue: an admin checks it before it's public.
venues.fullTitle: You're using every place on your plan
venues.fullBody: {plan} allows {max, plural, one {# venue} other {# venues}}, and they're all in use. To add another, move to a plan with more places.
venuePage.waitingLine: Sent {date}. Tourists see the live venue until an admin approves the change.
venuePage.narrationLead: Wayfare makes the story in each language your plan covers, from your Vietnamese description.
venuePage.radiusValue: {n} m — tourists hear it once they are within {n} m
venuePage.setWhy: Wayfare sets these for every venue, so no story wins a place in line by money. They can't be bought or changed here. Auto-narration (your plan) only decides whether the story may start by itself.
venuePage.closeBody: It leaves the map and Explore at once, and keeps everything: details, photos, menu, audio, and its QR stickers, which tell tourists it's closed. Reopen it whenever you like, with no review; it comes back once its audio is ready.
venuePage.closedBody: It left the map. Reopen it whenever you like.
venuePage.reopenBody: It returns to the map once its audio is ready. No review is needed.
venuePage.reopenLimit: {plan} allows {max, plural, one {# venue} other {# venues}}, and they're in use. Move to a plan with more places, or close another venue first.
venuePage.takenDownTitle: Wayfare took this venue off the map
venuePage.takenDownBody: On {date}. You can't reopen it yourself: write to support@wayfare.app to ask why and what to change.
venuePage.areaInactive: {area} is closed in Wayfare for now, so its venues can't reopen. We'll tell you when it opens again.
venuePage.notLive: Only a live venue can be closed for now.
venuePage.offMapBody: It left the map when your plan's places ran out. Nothing was deleted: move to a plan with more places, or close another venue, then reopen it.
ownerHome.lead: What needs you, then your venues at a glance.
ownerHome.dunning: Your last payment didn't go through. {plan} stays while Stripe tries again.
ownerHome.takenDown: Wayfare took {venue} off the map. You can't reopen it yourself.
ownerHome.unread: {n, plural, one {# new outcome} other {# new outcomes}}
ownerHome.places: Places: {used} of {max} used, {waiting} waiting for review
ownerHome.clear: Nothing needs you right now. Outcomes and anything that takes a venue off the map will show here.
ownerForm.newLead: Write in Vietnamese: Wayfare translates and narrates it. An admin reviews it before it's public.
ownerForm.editLead: Change what you need; the rest stays as it is. An admin reviews it before tourists see it.
ownerForm.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Quán ốc lâu đời trên phố Vĩnh Khánh, nổi tiếng với ốc hương rang muối ớt.
ownerForm.priceHelp: What a meal usually costs, as a band. Tourists filter by it.
ownerForm.websiteIssue: Use a full https:// address, like https://ocoanh.vn.
ownerForm.altPlaceholder: e.g. The grill at the front of the stall
ownerForm.photosHelp: Up to {max} on {plan}; JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB each. The first is the cover; drag to reorder.
ownerForm.photosAtMaxBody: {plan} allows {max} photos per venue, and this one has {n}. Remove one to add another.
ownerForm.photosAtMaxNext: {plan} allows {max} photos per venue, and this one has {n}. Remove one to add another, or move to {next} for up to {nextMax}.
ownerForm.dishesAtMax: {plan} allows {max} dishes, and this menu has {n}.
ownerForm.dishesAtMaxNext: {plan} allows {max} dishes, and this menu has {n}. {next} allows {nextMax}.
ownerForm.currencyHelp: One currency for the whole menu: đồng or US dollars.
ownerForm.dishPlaceholder: e.g. Ốc hương rang muối ớt
ownerForm.narrationTap: On {plan}, tourists hear this venue in {languages}, when they tap it.
ownerForm.narrationAuto: On {plan}, tourists hear this venue in {languages}; its story may start by itself as they walk near.
ownerForm.narrationNext: {next} adds {more}, and lets the story start by itself as they walk near.
ownerForm.newNote: An admin reviews it before it's public. While it waits, it holds one of your places.
ownerForm.editNote: An admin reviews the change. Tourists see the venue as it is until it's approved.
ownerForm.waitingTitle: A change is already waiting for review
ownerForm.waitingBody: Sent on {date}, it changes {fields}. Sending this one replaces it; an admin then reviews only this.
ownerForm.limitTitle: You're using every place on your plan
ownerForm.limitBody: {plan} allows {max} places: your venues and {waiting} waiting for review use them. Close one, or move to a plan with more. What you typed is kept.
ownerForm.conflictBody: Someone changed {venue} after you opened it. Your changes are kept: reload to see the venue as it is now, then send again.
ownerForm.outside: That spot is outside the areas Wayfare covers ({areas}). Move the pin inside one.
ownerForm.photoLimit: Your plan allows fewer photos than this. Remove some, then send again.
ownerForm.menuLimit: Your plan allows fewer dishes than this. Remove some, then send again.
upload.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: {size} MB — use a photo under 5 MB
upload.UPLOAD_TYPE_MISMATCH: Not a photo — use JPEG, PNG or WebP
upload.UPLOAD_NOT_READY: That photo expired before it was saved. Add it again.
upload.UPLOAD_HEIC: HEIC isn't accepted — export it as JPEG (on iPhone: Settings › Camera › Formats › Most Compatible)
error.UPLOAD_HEIC: HEIC photos aren't accepted. Export it as JPEG first.
sent.title: Sent for review
sent.reviews: An admin reviews {venue}; you'll hear in the bell.
sent.live: Once approved, it goes live as soon as its audio is ready — usually within minutes.
sent.holds: Until then it holds one of your places.
mySubs.title: My submissions
mySubs.lead: Every new venue and change you sent, and what Wayfare decided.
mySubs.more: {count, plural, one {# more submission} other {# more submissions}}
mySubs.empty: Nothing sent yet. A new venue or a change you propose shows here.
mySub.waitingBody: An admin reviews it; you'll hear in the bell. Sending another change to {venue} replaces this one.
mySub.proposedLead: Only what changes; the rest stays as it is.
mySub.withdrawBody: Wayfare stops reviewing it; send it again whenever you like. A new venue gives back its place.
notifications.lead: What Wayfare decided, and anything that needs you. Newest first.
ob.title: Plan and billing
ob.lead: What your plan gives your venues. Paying, your card and invoices are on Stripe's secure pages.
ob.retries: Stripe tries the card again over the next days
ob.goingBody: Change your plan or card, see invoices or cancel on Stripe's page; you come back here after.
ob.autoOn: On: your venues' stories start by themselves as a tourist walks near
ob.autoOff: Off: a story plays when a tourist taps it
ob.noLouder: No plan buys a louder voice, a wider circle or a higher place in line: Wayfare sets those for every venue alike.
ob.noInvoices: No invoices yet. They appear here once you subscribe.
ob.pinnedBody: Wayfare set some of your limits by hand: {limits}. They stay when your plan renews, until Wayfare changes them.
ob.dunningBody: {plan} stays while Stripe tries again over the next days. If every try fails you move to Free: nothing is deleted, but venues past Free's one place leave the map until you pay.
ob.cancelBody: Then you're on Free: nothing is deleted, but venues past Free's one place leave the map, the newest first, and stories play only when tapped. Resume in Stripe to keep {plan}.
ob.endedTitle: {n, plural, one {# venue is} other {# venues are}} off the map
ob.endedBody: {venues} left the map when your subscription ended. Nothing was deleted: subscribe again to bring them back, or close {other} to reopen another.
ob.stripeDown: Stripe isn't answering, so invoices can't be shown. Your plan and limits are up to date.
ob.stripeNoAnswer: Stripe didn't answer. Try again in a moment. Your plan hasn't changed.
ob.subscriptionExists: You already have a plan: change it in Stripe.
ob.noCustomer: You haven't subscribed yet, so there's nothing to manage in Stripe. Choose a plan first.
ob.agreementOutdated: The owner agreement has a new version. Read it and accept it before subscribing.
ob.confirmingBody: Thanks — Stripe has your payment. Your plan changes the moment Stripe confirms it, usually within a few seconds. You can leave this page; you'll hear in the bell.
ob.confirmedAuto: Your venue's story now starts by itself.
ob.cancelledBody: Nothing was charged. Choose a plan whenever you're ready.
ob.stillBody: It's taking longer than usual. If you paid, your plan changes as soon as Stripe tells us — usually within minutes; you'll hear in the bell. Nothing is charged twice if you check again.
plansPage.title: Choose a plan
plansPage.lead: Pay on Stripe's secure page; your plan changes as soon as Stripe confirms it.
plansPage.autoOff: Stories play when a tourist taps them
plansPage.scope.EXTENDED: The launch languages and the long tail
plansPage.autoBody: Auto-narration lets your venue's story start by itself as a tourist walks near — under the same rules as every venue: Wayfare's radius and priority, and at most one venue story every ten minutes. No plan buys a louder voice, a wider circle or a higher place in line.
dunning.banner: Your last payment didn't go through. {plan} stays while Stripe tries again; update your card to keep it.
fakeStripe.checkoutBody: This stack runs a fake Stripe. Pay to send the events a paid Checkout sends, or cancel.
fakeStripe.portalBody: This stack runs a fake Stripe: there is nothing to manage here.
error.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email first: open the link we sent, then try again.
pin.discoveryBoostSlots: {n, plural, one {# discovery boost} other {# discovery boosts}}
ob.endedBodyNoOther: {venues} left the map when your subscription ended. Nothing was deleted: subscribe again to bring them back.
venues.fullBodyOne: {plan} allows one venue, and {venue} uses it. To add another, move to a plan with more places.
venuePage.reopenLimitOne: {plan} allows one venue, and {other} uses it. Move to a plan with more places, or close {other} first.
venuePage.photoCount: {count} of {max} photos · the first is the cover
ownerForm.limitBodyOne: {plan} allows one venue, and {venue} uses it. Close it, or move to a plan with more places. What you typed is kept.
ownerForm.limitBodyNoWaiting: {plan} allows {max} places, and your venues use them all. Close one, or move to a plan with more places. What you typed is kept.
boosts.title: Discovery boosts
boosts.firewall: A boost puts a live venue higher in the lists and on the map where tourists browse, always labelled Sponsored. It never touches the stories: which one plays, when it starts and how loud it is stay the same for every venue.
boosts.freeOne: A slot is free — choose a venue to boost.
boosts.freeMany: {n} slots are free — choose venues to boost.
boosts.freeYour: Your slot is free — choose a venue to boost.
boosts.gives: {n, plural, one {# venue at a time} other {# venues at a time}}
boosts.free: Free has no boost slots. Growth gives one venue a boost, Pro five — they come with the plan; nothing is paid per boost.
boosts.endedWhy.left: ended when it left the map
boosts.endedWhy.plan: ended when the plan changed to {plan}
boosts.alertClosed: You closed {venue} for now on {date}, so its boost ended. Reopen it to boost it again, or choose another venue.
boosts.alertLeft: {venue} left the map on {date}, so its boost ended. Choose another venue to boost.
boosts.alertPlanNone: Your plan changed to {plan} on {date}, which has no boost slots, so {venue}'s boost ended. Its story was never affected.
boosts.alertPlanFewer: Your plan changed to {plan} on {date}, which has fewer boost slots, so {venue}'s boost ended. Its story was never affected.
boosts.chooserLead: {slots, plural, one {{plan} boosts one venue at a time.} other {{plan} boosts {words} venues at a time.}} Only live venues can be boosted.
boosts.notLive.PROCESSING: Getting its audio ready — it can be boosted once it's live.
boosts.notLive.ADMIN: Off the map — Wayfare took it down, so it can't be boosted.
boosts.notLive.OWNER: Closed for now — reopen it to boost it.
boosts.notLive.ENTITLEMENT_LIMIT: Off the map — your plan has no room for it, so it can't be boosted.
boosts.chooserFoot: Boosted venues rise in lists and on the map, labelled Sponsored. Their stories play exactly as before.
boosts.over: {n} chosen — {slots, plural, one {{plan} boosts one venue at a time.} other {{plan} boosts {words} venues at a time.}} Untick one, or move to {bigger}, which boosts {biggerWords}.
boosts.overTop: {n} chosen — {plan} boosts {words} venues at a time. Untick one.
boosts.venueOn: Boosted since {date}. {venue} shows higher in the lists and on the map where tourists browse, labelled Sponsored. Its story plays exactly as before — the trigger radius and priority above don't change.
boosts.venueOff: Not boosted. A boost would show {venue} higher in the lists and on the map, labelled Sponsored — never its story: the trigger radius and priority above stay as they are.
boosts.venueSlotsUsed: {plan} has {n, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}}, used by {others}.
boosts.venueSlotsFree: {plan} has {n, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}}, and {free, plural, one {one is} other {# are}} free.
adminBoosts.lead: Slots come from the grants above. The owner chooses which venues; an admin changes how many with Change grants…
placeBoost.body: Boosted by its owner since {date} ({plan}: {n, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}}). It shows higher in the nearby list and on the map, labelled Sponsored. Narration is untouched: its trigger radius and priority stay Wayfare's.
placeBoost.unavailable: Couldn't load the boost: billing didn't answer. The rest of the page is current.
notification.BOOST_ENDED: {placeName}'s boost ended. {placeName} left the map, so its boost ended.
notification.BOOST_ENDED.closed: {placeName}'s boost ended. You closed {placeName} for now, so its boost ended. Reopen it, then choose it again on Plan and billing.
tours.title: Tours
tours.lead: Walks Wayfare's editors put together: places in order, each telling its own story. Only staff make tours — no owner can join or pay for one.
tours.editorial: Tours are chosen by Wayfare's editors
tours.emptyBody: A tour joins an area's Places in an order. Make the first one.
tours.noResultsBody: Try another search or clear the filters.
tour.textNote: Written in Vietnamese; translated as text only. A tour has no narration of its own — each stop plays its Place's story.
tour.linkBody: Scanning it opens this tour in Wayfare, or on the web without the app. The link and the code printed under it — {code} — never change.
tour.notLiveStop: Not live — skipped for tourists until it is
tour.gateBody: It goes live by itself as soon as its English text is ready — you don't need to come back. There is no audio to wait for: each stop is told by its Place.
tour.gateFailed: English text — couldn't be translated. Write it with Correct a translation.
tour.areaInactive: {area} is switched off, so its tours can't go live. Turn the area on first.
tour.deactivateBody: Tourists stop seeing it in the tours list; its link and QR stickers say it isn't available. Its stops stay on the map as Places. You can activate it again.
tour.deleteBody: It disappears for tourists, and its link and QR stickers say it isn't available. Its Places aren't touched. You can restore it later from Tours (Include deleted).
tour.changed: This tour changed while you were looking. Reload to see it as it is.
tourForm.newLead: A walk through one area's Places, in an order you choose. Write it in Vietnamese — Wayfare translates the text. Each stop tells its Place's own story.
tourForm.title: Title, in Vietnamese
tourForm.titleHint: Up to 160 characters. Wayfare translates it for each language.
tourForm.descriptionHint: What the walk is about, for the tours list and the tour's page. Translated as text only — a tour has no narration of its own.
tourForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Tour này dẫn bạn đi đâu, và vì sao nên đi?
tourForm.areaHint: Choose it first: the stops are Places of this area. To change it later, remove the stops.
tourForm.areaFixed: Fixed while the tour has stops — its stops are Places of this area.
tourForm.minutesHint: 10 to 600 — an easy pace, with each stop's story.
tourForm.recomputed: Recomputed as you add, order or remove stops. At least 2 live stops for tourists to see it.
tourForm.noStops: No stops yet. Search above, or tap a Place on the map.
tourForm.mapNote: Tap a Place on the map to add it; the line joins the stops in order. It is not a walking route — tourists find their own way between stops.
tourForm.addPlaceholder: Add a Place of {area} — search by name
tourForm.coverHint: Shown on the tours list and at the top of the tour's page. Landscape, at least 1600 px wide; JPEG, PNG or WebP under 5 MB.
tourForm.footNote: Requesting activation makes the tour live once its English text is ready. A tour with fewer than 2 live stops stays hidden from tourists.
tourForm.changedBody: Saving takes the tour off the map for a moment: the new text is translated first, and the tour comes back by itself once its English is ready (Processing). Stops, minutes and the cover change without that.
tourForm.attentionCreate: {n, plural, one {One thing needs attention} other {# things need attention}}. Nothing was created.
tourForm.attentionSave: {n, plural, one {One thing needs attention} other {# things need attention}}. Nothing was saved.
tourForm.needStops: Add at least 2 stops to request activation — tourists only see a tour with 2 live stops. Create it as a draft to finish later.
grants.vouchersPaused: Vouchers aren't sold yet (paused until venues can be paid); this grant takes effect when they are.
range.label: Range
range.order: The first day can't be after the last.
chart.loadFailed: Couldn't load the numbers. Try again.
stats.title: My stats
stats.lead: How your venues' stories were heard. Only tourists who agreed are counted, so these numbers show a part of everyone, never a person.
stats.acrossVenues: {n, plural, one {Across your # venue} other {Across your # venues}}
stats.inAppAndWeb: In the app and on the web
stats.perDayLine: Stories started at your venues each day, in Vietnam time.
stats.byTrigger: Narrations per day, by how they started
stats.byTriggerLine: Each bar is a day; its parts are walking by, tapping and scanning, from the bottom.
stats.exportRefused: Exports come with Pro. Your plan changed — refresh to see what it shows.
stats.exportFailed: Couldn't download the export. Try again.
stats.meaning.narrations: A story that started at this venue, however it started.
stats.meaning.stopped: Stories someone stopped before the end.
stats.meaning.opens: Your venue's page opened in the app or on the web.
stats.meaning.listening: How long people listened, finished or not.
stats.meaning.qr: Your sticker scanned — every scan is counted, with no one's details.
stats.meaning.footer: Only tourists who agreed to be counted appear here, and never one by one.
stats.growthBody: Growth counts how often each story starts and finishes, how long people listen, and every QR scan. Pro also shows how each story started — walking by, tapping or scanning — stories stopped early, page opens, and an export.
stats.started.walking: The story started by itself as someone walked near
stats.noneTitle: Stats come with Growth and Pro
stats.noneLead: Free shows no numbers — not zeros, just none. With Growth you'd see, for each venue:
stats.noneStarted: how often its story started and was played to the end
stats.noneScanned: how often its QR sticker was scanned
stats.nonePro: Pro adds how each story started — walking by, tapping or scanning — and an export. Only tourists who agree are counted, and never one by one.
stats.quietVenue: {venue} went live on {date}, and only tourists who agree to be counted appear here — so the first weeks look quiet. The numbers grow as more people walk by.
stats.quietAll: Only tourists who agree to be counted appear here — so the first weeks look quiet. The numbers grow as more people walk by.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.lead: How Wayfare is used, from tourists who agreed to be counted — always in totals, never a person.
analytics.sessionsNote: Times the app or the web app was opened
analytics.activePhonesNote: On an average day · from rotating anonymous ids, so a phone can count twice
analytics.audioLine: Which step of the audio ladder played each narration. A rising share of the phone's voice means downloads or on-request audio are failing.
analytics.tier.t1Line: From the cache or a download
analytics.tier.t2Line: Played while it was being made
analytics.languagesLine: The language each narration played in.
analytics.top.completedLine: Narrations played to the end, per Place.
analytics.top.ranking: Ranking here reads what tourists heard; nothing here changes what plays.
analytics.heat.key: Each square is about 150 m. Squares with fewer than 5 phones aren't shown.
analytics.heat.what1: A square is about 150 m across — the phone rounds its position to the square before sending, so no exact place ever leaves it.
analytics.heat.what2: Its shade is how many phones were in it during the hours chosen, over the days chosen. It's an estimate: the count keeps no ids.
analytics.heat.what3: Squares with fewer than 5 phones aren't shown, so quiet streets look empty — that's on purpose.
analytics.heat.listLine: The same squares as a list, for reading without the map.
analytics.heat.map: Heatmap of {area}. Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom.
analytics.act.alertBody: Every install reports only which area it's in, at most every 15 minutes — no id, no position finer than the area. It's for running the service, so it needs no consent and is never added to the consented numbers.
analytics.act.perHourLine: Each bar is an hour; the height is an estimate of installs active in the area.
analytics.empty.title: Nothing counted yet
analytics.empty.body: Numbers appear the night after the first tourist agrees to be counted and hears a story. Until then every total is empty — not zero.
stats.leadShort: How your venues' stories were heard.
account.googleMismatch: That's not the Google account on this Wayfare account. Continue with {googleEmail}.
account.googleInvalid: That didn't confirm it's you. Continue with Google again.
account.googleUnavailable: Google didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
account.confirmExpired: That took too long. Continue with Google again.
